Why is Aliemus regen on WoDs considered fine while on CoVs bad?
1 sec let me get in the game
aliemus generation is a % that increase the aliemus that the character generates 100 aliemus + 10% aliemus generation would be 110 (less in arc 2 rules if im not wrong)
aliemus REgeneration is flat aliemus after exalt
like in incalt it will increase the aliemus that the character generates by that % but the stat on the wheel is 14-15 aliemus flat after exalt
also, the more aliemus REGEN you have, the less you will get after exalt bc of diminishing return. this is my gdoll for example
So the flat value is balanced too low for it to be worth the opportunity cost
And neither regen nor generation are worth it
but people often use the brain, which is flat aliemus on allies after exalt
